project_type: Full-stack WebRTC calling app: Node.js + Express + Socket.io backend + Flutter mobile + React web frontend
build_system: npm (Node.js server) + flutter build (Flutter) + Vite (React web)
build_command: cd server && npm run build; cd ../apps/web && npm run build; cd ../mobile && flutter build apk
test_command: cd server && npm test; cd ../apps/web && npm run test
verification_instructions: Per MVP design §3.9: unit tests for auth/validation, integration test for 1-to-1 call flow, network tests (WiFi to WiFi), background incoming call test on Android/iOS, load test with 100+ concurrent sockets
snapshot_or_generated_files: Flutter build artifacts (APK, AAB); React Vite build output (dist/); server compiled JS if using TypeScript; TURN credentials are generated dynamically per call
environment_constraints: Firebase credentials must be in .env files (never committed); coturn server requires public IP with UDP/TCP 3478 and 5349 open; iOS APNs needs Apple Developer account (out of scope for MVP, scaffold only); Flutter hot reload requires iOS 13+ / Android 8+
contribution_requirements: Mobile-first MVP (Flutter priority) per spec §1.3 and user request; voice-only for MVP (video in Phase 2 per §1.4); self-hosted coturn config only (no provisioning automation); custom Socket.io signaling (not managed service); contacts require explicit acceptance before calling (§3.2 'pending' status); exact npm/flutter commands in plan
key_patterns: WebRTC signaling via Socket.io events (§3.3); Firebase UID as primary key; call state machine (missed/rejected/completed/failed); ICE candidate gathering and exchange; DTLS-SRTP media encryption implicit in WebRTC; TURN credential issue on-demand via REST API
directory_structure: Monorepo root contains /server (Node.js backend), /apps/mobile (Flutter), /apps/web (React Vite), /infra (coturn config and deployment scripts), /docs (API and deployment docs). Each package has own package.json, pubspec.yaml, or build config. Root .env stores shared secrets (Firebase, TURN master credentials).
